tr: Wa Yā Nūru nawwir ẓāhirī wa sarā’irī
Bi ḥubbi ka Yā Hādī wa qawwim ṭarīqanā
en: O Light, illuminate my disclosures and my secrets – With Your love, O Guide, establish our way

ar: وَ يَا بَاقِيًا بِكَ أَبْقِنَا فِيْكَ أَفْنِنَا
tr: Badī`un fa at ḥifnā badā’i`a ḥikmatin
Wa Yā Bāqiyan bi ka abqinā fīka afninā.
en: O Original, open for us the origins of wisdom – O Forever Remaining, by You let us remain forever annihilated in You.

tr: Wa Yā Wārithan warrithni `ilman wa ḥikmatan
en: O Inheritor, bequeath me with knowledge and wisdom – Right-Guiding, guide us to the paths of praise.

tr: Wa ḥusna yāqīnin Yā Ṣabūru wa waffinā.
en: Pour patience upon us, with gratitude and contentment – And the best of certainty, O Patient, in pay us in full.
With Your beautiful names, we called You, my Master – Accept our call, our Lord, and respond to us.
